name: Leeka
source: Has cat’s ears and tail, very soft silky skin, slightly swarthy. Much stronger and more enduring than a human, and also significantly more agile. Height and weight are not of human ratio because of the high density of muscles; that’s why cannot swim. Breast size 3.
